d:
More than 100 activists stormed a Microsoft data centre construction site in Amsterdam, scaling cranes and unfurling anti-AI banners as riot police moved in and arrests were reported. The protest, part of a wider campaign across 16 countries, targets the environmental cost of AI infrastructure, soaring energy and water demands, and Big Tech’s growing power. Microsoft says it respects peaceful protest but does not condone unlawful actions
